subject: Discovery recap — lock demo slot & trial playbook handoff

From: Alex Wu <alex.wu@healthsync.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery call recap (HealthSync)

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from my side and what we need to lock down to run a short pilot / evaluation: 

- Problem: We need an extractive+generative assistant for clinicians to surface relevant patient history and suggest next steps. Latency target ~200ms p95 for short prompts; cost is a concern.
- Success criteria: F1/precision on named-entity extraction > 0.85 for our prompt set; clinician task time reduced by ~20% in a pilot.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + VPC option required; we attached the security questionnaire that procurement asked to get started.

Next actions we discussed:
1) Lock a 60–90 minute technical deep-dive + demo with our clinical ML lead (Dr. Priya N.).
2) Get an eval charter / trial playbook and sample prompt set so our ML team can sanity check.
3) Procurement will need an initial SOW estimate and timelines.

Available windows next week (PDT): Mon 3/17 10:00–11:30, Tue 3/18 13:00–14:30, Wed 3/19 08:30–10:00. Prefer Wed morning.

I've attached the security questionnaire (security-questionnaire.xlsx) — procurement asked for that up front.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of ML Platform | HealthSync
attachments: security-questionnaire.xlsx

Alex — great to meet you today and thanks for the clear priorities. Summarizing and proposing concrete next steps below so we can lock calendars and get your team the artifacts they need.

Summary (short):
- Goal: clinician assistant with fast, accurate extraction + safe generation.
- Constraints: latency p95 ~200ms, SOC2/VPC, pilot success criteria you listed.

Proposed next steps (we can do all of the below in the deep-dive meeting):
- 60–75 minute technical deep-dive + demo: walk through integration patterns (prefix caching, batching strategy), model candidate tradeoffs, and prompt engineering for the clinical prompt set. Bring your ML lead + infra/security contacts.
- Deliverables before the deep-dive: eval charter (success metrics, sample prompts, dataset notes), an initial prompt-pack sample, and a short Ops checklist for data & network requirements.
- Procurement: we'll provide a preliminary SOW and hosting options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC) for budgeting.

Available slots (PDT) — please pick one or propose alternatives:
- Wed 2025-03-19 08:30–09:45
- Thu 2025-03-20 10:00–11:15
- Fri 2025-03-21 13:00–14:15

I'll also attach the eval charter template and a small prompt-pack sample so your ML lead can review ahead of time. Attachments: eval-charter-template.docx, prompt-pack-sample.json

If Wed 3/19 works, we'll send a calendar invite and include a one-page runbook for the pilot.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
